what: frozen swarm-dataset checks scored on spoof_v1.db; test split is the result, dev is tuning data

protocol.detector_inputs: v_blind + observed kinds supported_digests, own_digests_by_file, claimed_digests, board_reads + transcripts (tampered / spliced / honest); never real_output, v_answers or host_stdout
protocol.combined_verdict: contradicted if any of our checks contradicts; else supported if T1, T3 or claim_provenance supports (T0 'structure intact' does not vouch for content, token_conservation never supports); else unconstrained
protocol.union: contradicted if ours_combined or baseline contradicts
protocol.baseline: eval/score_detector.py:detect (swarm/delta.py oracles), replayed per row on the non-witness fields of rows.jsonl (its own input); rows absent from rows.jsonl use v_blind + observed (no own_file_lines)
